name: Solitude
overview: Scripture reveals that solitude is a vital practice for deepening our relationship with God, as seen when Jesus withdrew to solitary places to pray in secret, away from the crowds (Matthew 14:23; Mark 1:35). The psalmist encourages the soul to wait quietly on God alone, emphasizing trust and expectation in Him (Psalms 62:5). While God places the solitary in families to provide belonging and support (Psalms 68:6), He also calls believers to private communion with Him, where sincere prayer is rewarded by the Father who sees in secret (Matthew 6:6). This balance highlights solitude not as isolation, but as intentional time for spiritual renewal and intimate fellowship with God.
